title: History — Two Oceans Marathon
claims: The first Two Oceans race was held on Saturday 2 May 1970 over 35 miles from Impala Park; 26 runners started, 15 finished, the entry fee was 50 cents and Dirkie Steyn won barefoot in 3:55:50.
Thompson Magawana set the still-standing men's course record of 3:03:44 on 2 April 1988, also setting world bests for 30 miles and 50 km.
The 1998 edition moved the start to Main Road, Newlands and the finish to the University of Cape Town rugby fields.
In 2000 the cut-off was extended from 6:30 to 7 hours; Chapman's Peak Drive closed after fires and rockfalls, and the race used Ou Kaapse Weg for the next four years while keeping the 56 km distance.

verification.note: Official history page read in full on 2026-11-20. It records the 1970 first race, Magawana's 1988 record, the 1998 Newlands-to-UCT move and the 2000 cut-off/Chapman's Peak changes.
